summary: Comprehensive testing of Enhanced Website Projects page with Section/Phase sidebars and Client Feedback. Backend: 23/23 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features working correctly including sidebar navigation, Pages/Tasks tabs, Page sidebar with sections, Phase sidebar with 4 tabs, Client feedback system.

issues: React warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement suggested

critical_code_review_comments: WebsiteProjectsPage.js at 932 lines is well-structured with clear component separation (MetadataCard, PhaseStatCard, StatusBadge, ProjectModal)
website_projects_routes.py at 761 lines has comprehensive API coverage for projects, pages, sections, and feedback
Sidebar.js properly implements Website Development submenu with dynamic project list
All APIs properly exclude MongoDB _id field
Proper use of data-testid attributes for testability
Good use of fixed positioning for Page sidebar (w-80) and Phase sidebar (w-96, z-50)
seed_data_creation: Test sections and feedback created via Playwright testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Enhanced Website Projects page fully tested. NEW Features verified: 1) Sidebar with Website Development dropdown showing 'All Projects', individual project links with progress %, and 'New Project' link, 2) Pages/Tasks tabs with Add Page/Add Task buttons, 3) Page sidebar opens on row click showing sections with screenshots, 4) Section sidebar (Phase sidebar) with 4 tabs (Wireframe, UI, Dev, Content) each with Status dropdown and URL input, 5) Client feedback section with add/resolve functionality like Google Docs comments. NO MOCKED APIs - using real MongoDB backend.
